Desc_LiquidOil_C.name: Crude Oil
Desc_LiquidOil_C.desc: Refined into all kinds of Oil-based resources, like Fuel and Plastic.

Desc_NitrogenGas_C.name: Nitrogen Gas
Desc_NitrogenGas_C.desc: Has a variety of uses, including metallurgy, cooling, and Nitric Acid production. On MASSAGE-2 (AB)b, it can be extracted from underground gas wells.

Desc_OreIron_C.name: Iron Ore
Desc_OreIron_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
The most essential basic resource.

Desc_Coal_C.name: Coal
Desc_Coal_C.desc: Mainly used as fuel for vehicles & Coal-Powered Generators, or in Steel production.

Desc_OreCopper_C.name: Copper Ore
Desc_OreCopper_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
A basic resource primarily used for electricity.

Desc_Stone_C.name: Limestone
Desc_Stone_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
A basic resource primarily used for stable Foundations.

Desc_RawQuartz_C.name: Raw Quartz
Desc_RawQuartz_C.desc: Can be processed into Quartz Crystals and Silica, which both offer a variety of applications.

Desc_SAM_C.name: SAM
Desc_SAM_C.desc: Strange Alien Matter, commonly referred to as SAM, doesn't seem to follow the known laws of physics. It whispers of new possibilities.

Desc_OreBauxite_C.name: Bauxite
Desc_OreBauxite_C.desc: Used to produce Alumina, which can be further refined into the Aluminum Scrap required to produce Aluminum Ingots.

Desc_OreGold_C.name: Caterium Ore
Desc_OreGold_C.desc: Smelted into Caterium Ingots, which are primarily used for advanced electronics.

Desc_Sulfur_C.name: Sulfur
Desc_Sulfur_C.desc: Primarily used to produce Black Powder.

Desc_OreUranium_C.name: Uranium
Desc_OreUranium_C.desc:
A radioactive element.
Used to produce Encased Uranium Cells for Uranium Fuel Rods.

Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_Fuel_C.name: Packaged Fuel
Desc_Fuel_C.desc: Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.

Desc_HeavyOilResidue_C.name: Heavy Oil Residue
Desc_HeavyOilResidue_C.desc: A by-product of Plastic and Rubber production. Can be further refined into Fuel and Petroleum Coke.

Desc_DarkEnergy_C.name: Dark Matter Residue
Desc_DarkEnergy_C.desc:
Produced as a by-product of Quantum Encoding processes and alternatively generated in the Converter.

Various fields of science are still debating the nature and properties of Dark Matter. Meanwhile, FICSIT has found several applications for it in space-time manipulation.

Desc_QuantumEnergy_C.name: Excited Photonic Matter
Desc_QuantumEnergy_C.desc:
Excited Photonic Matter is essential for all production processes in the Quantum Encoder.

Formed in the Converter by inducing intense photon interactions through exposure to SAM in a high-energy environment.

Desc_IonizedFuel_C.name: Ionized Fuel
Desc_IonizedFuel_C.desc:
Fuel that has been ionized, allowing it to deliver incredible output.
Can be used as-is to power Fuel-Powered Generators, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles or the Jetpack.

Desc_RocketFuel_C.name: Rocket Fuel
Desc_RocketFuel_C.desc:
A high-impulse compressed gas fuel.
Can be used as-is to power Fuel-Powered Generators, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles or the Jetpack.

Desc_IronPlate_C.name: Iron Plate
Desc_IronPlate_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
One of the most basic parts.

Desc_IronRod_C.name: Iron Rod
Desc_IronRod_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
One of the most basic parts.

Desc_Cable_C.name: Cable
Desc_Cable_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
Primarily used to build Power Lines.

Desc_IronPlateReinforced_C.name: Reinforced Iron Plate
Desc_IronPlateReinforced_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
A sturdier and more durable Iron Plate.

Desc_Wire_C.name: Wire
Desc_Wire_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
One of the most basic parts.

Desc_IronIngot_C.name: Iron Ingot
Desc_IronIngot_C.desc: Used for crafting the most basic parts.

Desc_SteelIngot_C.name: Steel Ingot
Desc_SteelIngot_C.desc: Smelted from a combination of Iron Ore and Coal. Can be made into several parts used in building construction.

Desc_HazmatFilter_C.name: Iodine-Infused Filter
Desc_HazmatFilter_C.desc: Absorbs radioactive particles when used with the Hazmat Suit.

Desc_Filter_C.name: Gas Filter
Desc_Filter_C.desc: Filters out toxins and pollutants from the air when used with a Gas Mask.

Desc_AluminumCasing_C.name: Aluminum Casing
Desc_AluminumCasing_C.desc: A versatile container cast from Aluminum Ingots.

Desc_AluminumIngot_C.name: Aluminum Ingot
Desc_AluminumIngot_C.desc:
Smelted from Aluminum Scrap, which is refined from Alumina Solution.
Used to produce specialized aluminum-based parts.

Desc_AluminumPlate_C.name: Alclad Aluminum Sheet
Desc_AluminumPlate_C.desc: Used to make products that require high heat conduction or a high specific strength. Thin, lightweight, and highly durable.

Desc_AluminumScrap_C.name: Aluminum Scrap
Desc_AluminumScrap_C.desc: Refined from Alumina. Can be smelted into Aluminum Ingots for industrial usage.

Desc_Computer_C.name: Computer
Desc_Computer_C.desc: A complex logic machine that is used to control advanced behavior in other machines.

Desc_CopperIngot_C.name: Copper Ingot
Desc_CopperIngot_C.desc: Used for crafting the most basic parts.

Desc_CopperSheet_C.name: Copper Sheet
Desc_CopperSheet_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
Primarily used for Pipelines due to its high corrosion resistance.

Desc_ModularFrame_C.name: Modular Frame
Desc_ModularFrame_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
A multipurpose building block.

Desc_Motor_C.name: Motor
Desc_Motor_C.desc: Creates a mechanical force that is used to move things from machines to vehicles.

Desc_Rotor_C.name: Rotor
Desc_Rotor_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
The moving parts of a motor.

Desc_SteelPipe_C.name: Steel Pipe
Desc_SteelPipe_C.desc: Primarily used when constructing slightly more advanced buildings.

Desc_SteelPlate_C.name: Steel Beam
Desc_SteelPlate_C.desc: Primarily used when constructing slightly more advanced buildings.

Desc_SteelPlateReinforced_C.name: Encased Industrial Beam
Desc_SteelPlateReinforced_C.desc:
Simultaneously utilizes the compressive strength of concrete and the tensile strength of steel.
Mostly used as a stable base for constructing buildings.

Desc_PackagedIonizedFuel_C.name: Packaged Ionized Fuel
Desc_PackagedIonizedFuel_C.desc: Ionized Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.

Desc_PackagedRocketFuel_C.name: Packaged Rocket Fuel
Desc_PackagedRocketFuel_C.desc: Rocket Fuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.

Desc_TurboFuel_C.name: Packaged Turbofuel
Desc_TurboFuel_C.desc: Turbofuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.

Desc_Cement_C.name: Concrete
Desc_Cement_C.desc:
Used for building.
Good for stable Foundations.

Desc_IronScrew_C.name: Screws
Desc_IronScrew_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
One of the most basic parts.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_1_C.name: Smart Plating
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_1_C.desc: Project Part #1. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_2_C.name: Versatile Framework
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_2_C.desc: Project Part #2. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_3_C.name: Automated Wiring
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_3_C.desc: Project Part #3. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_4_C.name: Modular Engine
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_4_C.desc: Project Part #4. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_5_C.name: Adaptive Control Unit
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_5_C.desc: Project Part #5. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_6_C.name: Magnetic Field Generator
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_6_C.desc:
Project Part #7. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

These modular generators use superconducting magnets and vast amounts of electricity to produce a powerful and easily expandable magnetic field.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_7_C.name: Assembly Director System
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_7_C.desc:
Project Part #6. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

This extremely fast and precise computing system is specifically designed to direct the Project Assembly: Assembly Phase.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_8_C.name: Thermal Propulsion Rocket
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_8_C.desc:
Project Part #8. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Uses extreme heat to produce the high-pressure plasma required to get Project Assembly into motion.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_9_C.name: Nuclear Pasta
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_9_C.desc:
Project Part #9. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.
Power Usage: 500-1500 MW (1000 MW average).

Nuclear Pasta is extremely dense degenerate matter, formed when extreme pressure forces protons and electrons together into neutrons. It is theorized to exist naturally within the crust of neutron stars.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_11_C.name: Ballistic Warp Drive
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_11_C.desc:
Project Part #11. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

A large amount of force is required for the Warp Drives to activate, so sticking them to rockets was the logical next step. Additionally, results improved immensely when the observers were further removed from the Warp Drives upon activation.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_12_C.name: AI Expansion Server
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_12_C.desc:
Project Part #12. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.
Power Usage: 0-2000 MW (1000 MW average).

Growth is the metric by which we measure success.

Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_10_C.name: Biochemical Sculptor
Desc_SpaceElevatorPart_10_C.desc:
Project Part #10. Ship via the Space Elevator to complete phases of Project Assembly.

Years ahead of the competition, this top-of-the-line 3D printer is used for the production of synthetic biological resources.

Desc_Silica_C.name: Silica
Desc_Silica_C.desc: Derived from Raw Quartz. Commonly used to create glass structures, in advanced refinement processes, and for alternative production of electronics.

Desc_LiquidFuel_C.name: Fuel
Desc_LiquidFuel_C.desc: Can be used as-is to generate power, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles or the Jetpack.

Desc_Plastic_C.name: Plastic
Desc_Plastic_C.desc: Versatile and easy to manufacture, this material has a wide range of uses.

Desc_CircuitBoard_C.name: Circuit Board
Desc_CircuitBoard_C.desc: Advanced electronics that have a plethora of different uses.

Desc_Rubber_C.name: Rubber
Desc_Rubber_C.desc: A very flexible material that has a lot of friction.

Desc_PolymerResin_C.name: Polymer Resin
Desc_PolymerResin_C.desc: A by-product of Crude Oil refinement into Fuel. Commonly used to manufacture Plastic and Rubber.

Desc_PetroleumCoke_C.name: Petroleum Coke
Desc_PetroleumCoke_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
A carbon-rich material distilled from Heavy Oil Residue.
Used as a less efficient Coal replacement.

Desc_HighSpeedWire_C.name: Quickwire
Desc_HighSpeedWire_C.desc: Caterium's high conductivity and resistance to corrosion make it ideal for small, advanced electronics.

Desc_HighSpeedConnector_C.name: High-Speed Connector
Desc_HighSpeedConnector_C.desc: Connects multiple cables and wires in a very efficient way. Uses a standard pattern, so it has many varied applications.

Desc_NuclearWaste_C.name: Uranium Waste
Desc_NuclearWaste_C.desc:
The by-product of consuming Uranium Fuel Rods in a Nuclear Power Plant.
Non-Fissile Uranium can be extracted. Handle with caution.

Caution: HIGHLY Radioactive.

Desc_PlutoniumWaste_C.name: Plutonium Waste
Desc_PlutoniumWaste_C.desc:
The by-product of consuming Plutonium Fuel Rods in a Nuclear Power Plant.
Must be stored in a safe location. Handle with caution.

Caution: EXTREMELY Radioactive.

Desc_CoolingSystem_C.name: Cooling System
Desc_CoolingSystem_C.desc: Keeps advanced parts and buildings from exceeding efficient temperature levels.

Desc_CrystalOscillator_C.name: Crystal Oscillator
Desc_CrystalOscillator_C.desc: An electronic oscillator circuit that uses the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal to create an electrical signal with a precise frequency.

Desc_ModularFrameFused_C.name: Fused Modular Frame
Desc_ModularFrameFused_C.desc: A corrosion-resistant, nitride-hardened, highly-robust-yet-lightweight modular frame.

Desc_MotorLightweight_C.name: Turbo Motor
Desc_MotorLightweight_C.desc: A more complex and powerful version of the regular Motor.

Desc_QuartzCrystal_C.name: Quartz Crystal
Desc_QuartzCrystal_C.desc: Derived from Raw Quartz. Used in the production of advanced radar technology and high-quality display screens.

Desc_Stator_C.name: Stator
Desc_Stator_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
The static parts of a motor.

Desc_Crystal_C.name: Blue Power Slug
Desc_Crystal_C.desc: A strange slug radiating an unknown weak power.

Desc_Crystal_mk2_C.name: Yellow Power Slug
Desc_Crystal_mk2_C.desc: A strange slug radiating an unknown power.

Desc_Crystal_mk3_C.name: Purple Power Slug
Desc_Crystal_mk3_C.desc: A strange slug radiating a powerful unknown power.

Desc_Battery_C.name: Battery
Desc_Battery_C.desc: Primarily used as fuel for Drones and vehicles.

Desc_GoldIngot_C.name: Caterium Ingot
Desc_GoldIngot_C.desc: Smelted from Caterium Ore. Primarily used for advanced electronics.

Desc_CircuitBoardHighSpeed_C.name: AI Limiter
Desc_CircuitBoardHighSpeed_C.desc: Controls AIs and keeps them from evolving in malicious ways. Super advanced electronics.

Desc_NitricAcid_C.name: Nitric Acid
Desc_NitricAcid_C.desc: Produced when Nitrogen Gas reacts with Water. Its high corrosiveness and oxidizing properties make it an excellent choice for refinement and fuel production processes.

Desc_SulfuricAcid_C.name: Sulfuric Acid
Desc_SulfuricAcid_C.desc: Produced by combining Sulfur and Water in a complex reaction. Primarily used in refinement processes and Battery production.

Desc_GasTank_C.name: Empty Fluid Tank
Desc_GasTank_C.desc: Used to package gases and volatile liquids for transportation.

Desc_Gunpowder_C.name: Black Powder
Desc_Gunpowder_C.desc: An explosive powder that is commonly used to produce simple explosives.

Desc_PlutoniumCell_C.name: Encased Plutonium Cell
Desc_PlutoniumCell_C.desc:
Plutonium Pellets encased in concrete.
Used to produce Plutonium Fuel Rods for Nuclear Power production.

Power Usage: 250-750 MW (500 MW average).
Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_PlutoniumPellet_C.name: Plutonium Pellet
Desc_PlutoniumPellet_C.desc:
Produced in the Particle Accelerator through conversion of Non-fissile Uranium.
Used to produce Encased Plutonium Cells for Plutonium Fuel Rods.

Power Usage: 250-750 MW (500 MW average).
Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_PressureConversionCube_C.name: Pressure Conversion Cube
Desc_PressureConversionCube_C.desc: Converts outgoing force into internal pressure. Required to contain unstable, high-energy matter.

Desc_NonFissibleUranium_C.name: Non-Fissile Uranium
Desc_NonFissibleUranium_C.desc:
The Uranium-238 isotope is non-fissile, meaning it cannot be used for nuclear fission. It can, however, be converted into fissile Plutonium in the Particle Accelerator.

Caution: Mildly Radioactive.

Desc_ComputerSuper_C.name: Supercomputer
Desc_ComputerSuper_C.desc: The next-gen version of a Computer.

Desc_CopperDust_C.name: Copper Powder
Desc_CopperDust_C.desc:
Ground-up Copper Ingots.
The high natural density of Copper, combined with the granularity of the powder, makes this part perfect for producing Nuclear Pasta in the Particle Accelerator.

Desc_TimeCrystal_C.name: Time Crystal
Desc_TimeCrystal_C.desc: Time Crystals are Diamonds that have been reconfigured on a sub-atomic level in the Converter to retain a time-periodic self-organizing structure. This allows them to be used in the development of quantum processing and storage technologies.

Desc_Diamond_C.name: Diamonds
Desc_Diamond_C.desc:
Synthetic Diamonds produced by exposing Coal to extreme heat and pressure.

Used in the production of Time Crystals and Dark Matter Crystals.

Power Usage: 250-750 MW (500 MW average).

Desc_SAMFluctuator_C.name: SAM Fluctuator
Desc_SAMFluctuator_C.desc:
The SAM Fluctuator is able to regulate and direct the behavior of Reanimated SAM through the application of electric charges with varying frequencies.
This control facilitates technologies such as matter-to-energy conversion and spatiotemporal matter manipulation.

Desc_SAMIngot_C.name: Reanimated SAM
Desc_SAMIngot_C.desc:
The active and contained form of the Strange Alien Matter.

Proper electromagnetic containment is required, as it appears to be able to manipulate the atomic bonds of any matter it comes into contact with.

Desc_FicsiteIngot_C.name: Ficsite Ingot
Desc_FicsiteIngot_C.desc:
Produced by reconstructing other metals on a molecular level using Strange Alien Matter.

Synthesized by FICSIT to be the perfect construction material, and used in the most high-end processes.

Desc_FicsiteMesh_C.name: Ficsite Trigon
Desc_FicsiteMesh_C.desc: The Ficsite Trigon, made from Ficsite Ingots, is perfectly shaped for all construction challenges. Its performance is so exceptional, it basically solved structural engineering.

Desc_DarkMatter_C.name: Dark Matter Crystal
Desc_DarkMatter_C.desc:
Concentrated Dark Matter Residue that is isolated within a crystalline vessel. This form of containment allows for utilising Dark Matter reliably in other production processes.

Power Usage: 500-1500 MW (1000 MW average).

Desc_QuantumOscillator_C.name: Superposition Oscillator
Desc_QuantumOscillator_C.desc: An oscillator circuit that uses the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal to create a string vibration with a precise frequency. Often used in teleportation technology and dimensional manipulation.

Desc_TemporalProcessor_C.name: Neural-Quantum Processor
Desc_TemporalProcessor_C.desc: The Neural-Quantum Processor utilizes a combination of neural network architecture and quantum computing techniques to achieve unprecedented performance. This technology has enabled some of FICSIT's biggest advancements in artificial intelligence and relativistic engineering.

Desc_LiquidTurboFuel_C.name: Turbofuel
Desc_LiquidTurboFuel_C.desc: A more efficient alternative to Fuel. Can be used as-is to generate power, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles.

Desc_CompactedCoal_C.name: Compacted Coal
Desc_CompactedCoal_C.desc: A much more efficient alternative to Coal. Used as fuel for vehicles and Coal-Powered Generators.

Desc_UraniumCell_C.name: Encased Uranium Cell
Desc_UraniumCell_C.desc:
Used to produce Uranium Fuel Rods for Nuclear Power production. Made from Uranium Ore.

Caution: Mildly Radioactive.

Desc_AluminaSolution_C.name: Alumina Solution
Desc_AluminaSolution_C.desc: Dissolved Alumina, extracted from Bauxite. Can be further refined into Aluminum Scrap for Aluminum Ingot production.

Desc_FluidCanister_C.name: Empty Canister
Desc_FluidCanister_C.desc: Used to package fluids for transportation.

Desc_PackagedOil_C.name: Packaged Oil
Desc_PackagedOil_C.desc: Crude Oil, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles.

Desc_PackagedOilResidue_C.name: Packaged Heavy Oil Residue
Desc_PackagedOilResidue_C.desc: Heavy Oil Residue, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles.

Desc_GunpowderMK2_C.name: Smokeless Powder
Desc_GunpowderMK2_C.desc: An explosive powder that is commonly used to produce modern firearms.

Desc_AlienProtein_C.name: Alien Protein
Desc_AlienProtein_C.desc:
Ground-up Alien Remains in a neat little package.
Used for medical purposes and to research alien organisms.

Desc_XmasStar_C.name: FICSMAS Wonder Star
Desc_XmasStar_C.desc: A symbol of appreciation for all the hard work FICSIT has done for its employees. It seems to have an aura of gratitude. Seeing this also means the seasonal event is nearly done, and we can finally get back to Saving The Day.

Desc_XmasBallCluster_C.name: FICSMAS Ornament Bundle
Desc_XmasBallCluster_C.desc: A collection of FICSMAS ornaments and also an eyesore.

Desc_XmasBranch_C.name: FICSMAS Tree Branch
Desc_XmasBranch_C.desc: This FICSMAS Tree Branch is very different from regular tree branches: it's used to produce parts and buildings during the FICSMAS event, rather than for combustion.

Desc_XmasWreath_C.name: FICSMAS Wreath
Desc_XmasWreath_C.desc: FICSIT's newest holiday innovation: decorations that can be turned into decorations! Efficiency and waste-conscious design at its best.

Desc_XmasDataCartridge4_C.name: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 14
Desc_XmasDataCartridge4_C.desc: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 14, used to progress FICSMAS MAM research.

Desc_Gift_C.name: FICSMAS Gift
Desc_Gift_C.desc:
Gifts that have inexplicably fallen from the sky or spawned from a FICSMAS Gift Tree.

Don’t question it—they’re used to produce FICSMAS buildings and parts.

These Gifts are part of the FICSMAS Event, like the calendar in the HUB.

Desc_Snow_C.name: FICSMAS Actual Snow
Desc_Snow_C.desc: This Actual Snow is made from several chemical elements and experiences 100% like naturally occuring snow after extensive user testing.

Desc_CandyCane_C.name: Candy Cane
Desc_CandyCane_C.desc:
A delicious Candy Cane to be enjoyed during the FICSMAS Holidays.
*Disclaimer: Not for human consumption...

Desc_XmasBow_C.name: FICSMAS Bow
Desc_XmasBow_C.desc: A fancy bow. Not for wearing, eating, admiring, Lizard Doggos, humans, aliens, or anything not related to FICSMAS factory production.

Desc_XmasDataCartridge3_C.name: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 8
Desc_XmasDataCartridge3_C.desc: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 8, used to progress FICSMAS MAM research.

Desc_XmasBall1_C.name: Red FICSMAS Ornament
Desc_XmasBall1_C.desc: An ornament for making FICSMAS Decorations. An acceptable red.

Desc_XmasBall2_C.name: Blue FICSMAS Ornament
Desc_XmasBall2_C.desc: An ornament for making FICSMAS Decorations. A mildly pleasing blue.

Desc_XmasBall3_C.name: Copper FICSMAS Ornament
Desc_XmasBall3_C.desc: An ornament for making FICSMAS Decorations. A slightly dignified copper.

Desc_XmasBall4_C.name: Iron FICSMAS Ornament
Desc_XmasBall4_C.desc: An ornament for making FICSMAS Decorations. An okay iron.

Desc_XmasDataCartridge2_C.name: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 4
Desc_XmasDataCartridge2_C.desc: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 4, used to progress FICSMAS MAM research.

Desc_XmasDataCartridge1_C.name: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 1
Desc_XmasDataCartridge1_C.desc: FICSMAS Data Cartridge Day 1, used to progress FICSMAS MAM research.

Desc_WAT2_C.name: Mercer Sphere
Desc_WAT2_C.desc: A weird alien phenomenon. While the sphere appears liquid, it behaves like a solid and does not have any detectable mass. It seems to somehow interact with and have awareness of its environment.

Desc_SingularityCell_C.name: Singularity Cell
Desc_SingularityCell_C.desc: Used to break down space and time. Required to power Portals.

Desc_AlienDNACapsule_C.name: Alien DNA Capsule
Desc_AlienDNACapsule_C.desc:
Translates organic chemicals into readable alien genetic information.
Used for researching alien organisms.

Go the extra kilometer! Knowledge is power, and power is just efficiency with fewer steps. Depositing Alien DNA Capsules in the AWESOME Sink provides FICSIT with knowledge, and pioneers with Coupons.

Desc_Ficsonium_C.name: Ficsonium
Desc_Ficsonium_C.desc:
Usage and production of this material is strictly prohibited. On Earth, that is. There are no rules in space, only efficiency.

Power Usage: 500-1500 MW (1000 MW average).
Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_DissolvedSilica_C.name: Dissolved Silica
Desc_DissolvedSilica_C.desc:
Silica dissolved in Water, produced as part of the alternative refinement of Raw Quartz.
The Silica can be extracted from the Water to complete the refinement process.

Desc_Biofuel_C.name: Solid Biofuel
Desc_Biofuel_C.desc: The most energy-efficient form of solid Biomass. Can be used as fuel for the Chainsaw.

Desc_Wood_C.name: Wood
Desc_Wood_C.desc:
Primarily used as fuel.
Biomass Burners and vehicles can use Wood for power.

Desc_Leaves_C.name: Leaves
Desc_Leaves_C.desc:
Primarily used as fuel.
Biomass Burners and vehicles can use Leaves for power.

Desc_PackagedBiofuel_C.name: Packaged Liquid Biofuel
Desc_PackagedBiofuel_C.desc: Liquid Biofuel, packaged for alternative transport. Can be used as fuel for vehicles and the Jetpack.

Desc_GenericBiomass_C.name: Biomass
Desc_GenericBiomass_C.desc:
Primarily used as fuel.
Biomass Burners and vehicles can use it for power.
Biomass is much more energy-efficient than raw biological matter.

Desc_HogParts_C.name: Hog Remains
Desc_HogParts_C.desc:
The carapace of an alien Hog creature.
Used for MAM research.

Desc_SpitterParts_C.name: Spitter Remains
Desc_SpitterParts_C.desc:
The remains of a plasma-spitting alien creature.
Used for MAM research.

Desc_PackagedNitricAcid_C.name: Packaged Nitric Acid
Desc_PackagedNitricAcid_C.desc: Nitric Acid, packaged for alternative transport.

Desc_PackagedNitrogenGas_C.name: Packaged Nitrogen Gas
Desc_PackagedNitrogenGas_C.desc: Nitrogen Gas, packaged for alternative transport.

Desc_PackagedAlumina_C.name: Packaged Alumina Solution
Desc_PackagedAlumina_C.desc: Alumina Solution, packaged for alternative transport.

Desc_LiquidBiofuel_C.name: Liquid Biofuel
Desc_LiquidBiofuel_C.desc: Liquid Biofuel can be used as-is to generate power, or packaged to be used as fuel for vehicles.

Desc_Fabric_C.name: Fabric
Desc_Fabric_C.desc:
Used to craft equipment.
Flexible but durable fabric.

Desc_Mycelia_C.name: Mycelia
Desc_Mycelia_C.desc:
Used for crafting.
Biomass Burners and vehicles can also use Mycelia for power.

Desc_StingerParts_C.name: Stinger Remains
Desc_StingerParts_C.desc:
The remains of whatever that creepy thing was.
Used for MAM research.

Desc_HatcherParts_C.name: Hatcher Remains
Desc_HatcherParts_C.desc:
The shell-like remains of an alien... thing.
Used for MAM research.

Desc_PackagedSulfuricAcid_C.name: Packaged Sulfuric Acid
Desc_PackagedSulfuricAcid_C.desc: Sulfuric Acid, packaged for alternative transport.

Desc_NuclearFuelRod_C.name: Uranium Fuel Rod
Desc_NuclearFuelRod_C.desc:
Used as fuel for Nuclear Power Plants.

Caution: Produces radioactive Uranium Waste when consumed.
Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_PlutoniumFuelRod_C.name: Plutonium Fuel Rod
Desc_PlutoniumFuelRod_C.desc:
Used as fuel for Nuclear Power Plants.

Caution: Produces radioactive Plutonium Waste when consumed.
Caution: HIGHLY Radioactive.

Desc_FicsoniumFuelRod_C.name: Ficsonium Fuel Rod
Desc_FicsoniumFuelRod_C.desc:
Used as fuel for Nuclear Power Plants.
The power source that put FICSIT on the map. Literally. The crater is still there.

Caution: Moderately Radioactive.

Desc_CrystalShard_C.name: Power Shard
Desc_CrystalShard_C.desc:
Power Slug mucus compressed into a solid crystal-like shard.
It radiates a strange power.

Desc_WAT1_C.name: Somersloop
Desc_WAT1_C.desc: An odd alien object with a mind-bending, yet somehow familiar shape. It emits an unsettling energy.

Desc_AlienPowerFuel_C.name: Alien Power Matrix
Desc_AlienPowerFuel_C.desc:
This intricate condensed-matter matrix is used to enhance the output of the Alien Power Augmenter.

Initially developed in efforts to create a human-made Somersloop, the Alien Power Matrix cannot sustain the extra-dimensional energy connection on its own. However, it can effectively stabilize the energy stream of the Somersloop.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorShockShank_C.name: Xeno-Zapper
BP_EquipmentDescriptorShockShank_C.desc: A standard issue self-defense electroshock melee weapon.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorObjectScanner_C.name: Object Scanner
BP_EquipmentDescriptorObjectScanner_C.desc: Scans the area for a selected item. Beeps at a rate proportional to proximity and direction.

Desc_RebarGunProjectile_C.name: Rebar Gun
Desc_RebarGunProjectile_C.desc: An improvised ranged weapon for self-defense. Has to be reloaded after each use.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorRifle_C.name: Rifle
BP_EquipmentDescriptorRifle_C.desc: A long-range, rapid-fire weapon. Specifically designed to deliver adequate performance within the designated work area.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorGasmask_C.name: Gas Mask
BP_EquipmentDescriptorGasmask_C.desc:
Allows pioneers to breathe normally in toxic gas-filled areas.
Consumes Gas Filters from the pioneer's inventory when in use.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorJetPack_C.name: Jetpack
BP_EquipmentDescriptorJetPack_C.desc:
Allows pioneers to travel through the air with increased control.

Fuel is automatically consumed from the pioneer's inventory to refill the Jetpack while on the ground.
Different fuel types can be used and provide different levels of Jetpack efficiency. The preferred fuel type will be used if available, and can be set in the equipment inventory.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorNobeliskDetonator_.name: Nobelisk Detonator
BP_EquipmentDescriptorNobeliskDetonator_.desc: A remote-control device used to handle and detonate Nobelisks.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorHazmatSuit_C.name: Hazmat Suit
BP_EquipmentDescriptorHazmatSuit_C.desc:
Shields pioneers from the adverse effects of radiation.
Consumes Iodine-Infused Filters from the pioneer's inventory when worn in radioactive areas.

BP_ItemDescriptorPortableMiner_C.name: Portable Miner
BP_ItemDescriptorPortableMiner_C.desc:
Automatically extracts a resource when placed on a resource node.
Note: Has limited storage space.

Desc_GolfCart_C.name: Factory Cart™
Desc_GolfCart_C.desc:
The one and only FICSIT Factory Cart™.
Now with special FICSIT-Foundation-only Grip Wheels, for an even smoother and faster factory floor experience!

Desc_GolfCartGold_C.name: Golden Factory Cart™
Desc_GolfCartGold_C.desc:
The one and only Golden FICSIT Factory Cart™

You have now officially ascended.
Go forth now, Master of Spaghetti, God of the Factory, Sinker of Cups, Employee of the Planet... travel in STYLE!

Desc_Chainsaw_C.name: Chainsaw
Desc_Chainsaw_C.desc:
Clears an area of flora that is too difficult to remove by hand.

Fuel: Biofuel

BP_EquipmentDescriptorCandyCane_C.name: Candy Cane Basher
BP_EquipmentDescriptorCandyCane_C.desc: Self-defense is now not only fun, but also delicious for the target! Do not lick or consume.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorJumpingStilts_C.name: Blade Runners
BP_EquipmentDescriptorJumpingStilts_C.desc:
An exoskeleton for the lower legs that assists movement, allowing pioneers to sprint faster and jump higher.
Also dampens the impact of landing.

BP_EqDescZipLine_C.name: Zipline
BP_EqDescZipLine_C.desc:
Provides faster traversal of factories by allowing pioneers to zip along Power lines.
Activate the Zipline and aim at a nearby Power Line to connect to it.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorHoverPack_C.name: Hoverpack
BP_EquipmentDescriptorHoverPack_C.desc:
Power Consumption: 100 MW

Allows pioneers to move vertically and hover in mid-air to improve building efficiency and factory traversal. Wirelessly connects to nearby power connections, such as Power Poles and Buildings, for power consumption.

Slow-Fall: Hold {PlayerMovement_Jump} after losing connection mid-air.
Disable Hoverpack: Double tap {PlayerMovement_Crouch} while hovering.

BP_EquipmentDescriptorStunSpear_C.name: Xeno-Basher
BP_EquipmentDescriptorStunSpear_C.desc: A heavy self-defense electroshock melee weapon.

Desc_Berry_C.name: Paleberry
Desc_Berry_C.desc:
Consumable

Eat to restore 1 health segment.

Desc_Nut_C.name: Beryl Nut
Desc_Nut_C.desc:
Consumable

Eat to restore half a health segment.

Desc_Medkit_C.name: Medicinal Inhaler
Desc_Medkit_C.desc:
Fully restores health when used.

The FICSIT Medicinal Inhaler can be produced from a variety of different ingredients.

Desc_Shroom_C.name: Bacon Agaric
Desc_Shroom_C.desc:
Consumable

Eat to restore 2 health segments.

Desc_Parachute_C.name: Parachute
Desc_Parachute_C.desc: Slows down your fall when activated in mid-air.

Desc_Fireworks_Projectile_03_C.name: Sparkly Fireworks
Desc_Fireworks_Projectile_03_C.desc: Keep away from easily distracted pioneers.

Desc_Fireworks_Projectile_02_C.name: Fancy Fireworks
Desc_Fireworks_Projectile_02_C.desc: Poses acceptable amount of risk to pioneers.

Desc_SnowballProjectile_C.name: Snowball
Desc_SnowballProjectile_C.desc: Compressed dihydrogen monoxide crystals for weaponized fun!

Desc_Rebar_Explosive_C.name: Explosive Rebar
Desc_Rebar_Explosive_C.desc: Explodes on impact, dealing heavy damage.

Desc_Rebar_Stunshot_C.name: Stun Rebar
Desc_Rebar_Stunshot_C.desc:
Electrocutes the target on impact, stunning it for a short time.

Stun Duration: 5 seconds

Desc_SpikedRebar_C.name: Iron Rebar
Desc_SpikedRebar_C.desc: Can be shot using the Rebar Gun for self-defense purposes.

Desc_CartridgeSmartProjectile_C.name: Homing Rifle Ammo
Desc_CartridgeSmartProjectile_C.desc:
The bullet guidance system built into this ammunition allows it to accurately hit any target within the reticle area.
Especially useful when dealing with agile threats, or for pioneers who can't be bothered to aim properly.

Desc_NobeliskExplosive_C.name: Nobelisk
Desc_NobeliskExplosive_C.desc: A simple explosive, useful for clearing boulders, vegetation, and other obstacles.

Desc_NobeliskCluster_C.name: Cluster Nobelisk
Desc_NobeliskCluster_C.desc: Detonates into multiple smaller explosions. Practical for clearing out large areas of vegetation and other inconveniences.

Desc_NobeliskGas_C.name: Gas Nobelisk
Desc_NobeliskGas_C.desc: Creates a deadly gas cloud instead of a regular explosion.

Desc_NobeliskNuke_C.name: Nuke Nobelisk
Desc_NobeliskNuke_C.desc:
Uses a nuclear fission reaction to generate a massive explosion.
WARNING: Ensure all FICSIT property is clear of the blast zone before detonation.

Desc_NobeliskShockwave_C.name: Pulse Nobelisk
Desc_NobeliskShockwave_C.desc: Generates a powerful shockwave instead of a regular explosion.

Desc_Rebar_Spreadshot_C.name: Shatter Rebar
Desc_Rebar_Spreadshot_C.desc: Fractures when shot, launching deadly debris with wide spread but limited range.

Desc_CartridgeChaos_C.name: Turbo Rifle Ammo
Desc_CartridgeChaos_C.desc: Lightweight, compact, and volatile. These rounds provide extreme capacity and rate of fire at the cost of accuracy.

Desc_CartridgeStandard_C.name: Rifle Ammo
Desc_CartridgeStandard_C.desc: Standard issue Rifle ammunition, useful for establishing dominance.

Build_ConstructorMk1_C.name: Constructor
Build_ConstructorMk1_C.desc:
Crafts 1 part into another part.

Can be automated by feeding component parts in via a Conveyor Belt connected to the input port. The resulting parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.

Build_SmelterMk1_C.name: Smelter
Build_SmelterMk1_C.desc:
Smelts ore into ingots.

Can be automated by feeding ore in via a Conveyor Belt connected to the input port. The resulting ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.

Build_FoundryMk1_C.name: Foundry
Build_FoundryMk1_C.desc:
Smelts 2 resources into alloy ingots.

Can be automated by feeding ore in via Conveyor Belts connected to the input ports. The resulting ingots can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.

Build_OilRefinery_C.name: Refinery
Build_OilRefinery_C.desc:
Refines fluid and/or solid parts into other parts.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Has both Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input and output ports so that a wide range of recipes can be automated.

Build_Packager_C.name: Packager
Build_Packager_C.desc:
Packages and unpackages fluids.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Has both Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input and output ports so that a wide range of recipes can be automated.

Build_ManufacturerMk1_C.name: Manufacturer
Build_ManufacturerMk1_C.desc:
Crafts 3 or 4 parts into another part.

Can be automated by feeding component parts in via Conveyor Belts connected to the input ports. The resulting parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.

Build_AssemblerMk1_C.name: Assembler
Build_AssemblerMk1_C.desc:
Crafts 2 parts into another part.

Can be automated by feeding component parts in via Conveyor Belts connected to the input ports. The resulting parts can be automatically extracted by connecting a Conveyor Belt to the output port.

Build_Blender_C.name: Blender
Build_Blender_C.desc:
Blends fluids together or combines them with solid parts in a wide variety of processes.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Has both Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input and output ports.

Build_HadronCollider_C.name: Particle Accelerator
Build_HadronCollider_C.desc:
Uses electromagnetic fields to propel particles to very high speeds and energies. The specific design allows for a variety of processes, including matter generation and conversion.

Warning: Power usage is extremely high and unstable, and varies per recipe.

Build_Converter_C.name: Converter
Build_Converter_C.desc:
The Converter harnesses Reanimated SAM to enable precise matter and energy transmutation.

Warning: Power usage is very high and unstable.

Build_QuantumEncoder_C.name: Quantum Encoder
Build_QuantumEncoder_C.desc:
The Quantum Encoder uses Excited Photonic Matter to produce the most complex of parts, controlling development up to the quantum level.

Warning: Power usage is extremely high and unstable.

Build_MinerMk1_C.name: Miner Mk.1
Build_MinerMk1_C.desc:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on.
Default extraction rate is 60 resources per minute.
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.

Build_OilPump_C.name: Oil Extractor
Build_OilPump_C.desc:
Extracts Crude Oil when built on an oil node. Extraction rates vary based on node purity.

Default Extraction Rate: 120 m³ of oil per minute.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Build_MinerMk2_C.name: Miner Mk.2
Build_MinerMk2_C.desc:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on.
Default extraction rate is 120 resources per minute.
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.

Build_MinerMk3_C.name: Miner Mk.3
Build_MinerMk3_C.desc:
Extracts solid resources from the resource node it is built on.
Default extraction rate is 240 resources per minute.
Extraction rate varies based on resource node purity. Outputs all extracted resources onto connected Conveyor Belts.

Build_WaterPump_C.name: Water Extractor
Build_WaterPump_C.desc:
Extracts water from the body of water it is built on.
Note: the water needs to be sufficiently deep, and rivers are generally not deep enough.

Default Extraction Rate: 120 m³ of water per minute.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Build_FrackingExtractor_C.name: Resource Well Extractor
Build_FrackingExtractor_C.desc:
Collects pressurized resources when placed on the activated sub-nodes of a Resource Well. Does not require power.

Default Extraction Rate: 60 m³ of fluid per minute.
Head Lift: 10 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 10 meters upwards.)

Build_FrackingSmasher_C.name: Resource Well Pressurizer
Build_FrackingSmasher_C.desc:
Activates a Resource Well by pressurizing the underground resource. Must be placed on a Resource Well.
Once activated, Resource Well Extractors can be placed on the surrounding sub-nodes to extract the resource.
Requires power. Overclocking increases the output potential of the entire Resource Well.

Build_GeneratorBiomass_Automated_C.name: Biomass Burner
Build_GeneratorBiomass_Automated_C.desc:
Burns various forms of Biomass to generate electricity for the power grid.
Has a Conveyor Belt input port that allows the Biomass supply to be automated.

Resource consumption will automatically be lowered to meet power demands.

Build_GeneratorCoal_C.name: Coal-Powered Generator
Build_GeneratorCoal_C.desc:
Burns Coal to boil Water. The steam produced rotates turbines that generate electricity for the power grid.
Has Conveyor Belt and Pipeline input ports that allow the Coal and Water supply to be automated.

Caution: Always generates power at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.

Build_GeneratorFuel_C.name: Fuel-Powered Generator
Build_GeneratorFuel_C.desc:
Consumes Fuel to generate electricity for the power grid.
Has a Pipeline input port that allows the Fuel supply to be automated.

Caution: Always generates power at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.

Build_GeneratorNuclear_C.name: Nuclear Power Plant
Build_GeneratorNuclear_C.desc:
Consumes Nuclear Fuel Rods and Water to produce electricity for the power grid.

Produces Nuclear Waste, which is extracted via the Conveyor Belt output.

Caution: Always generates power at the set clock speed. Shuts down if fuel requirements are not met.

Build_GeneratorGeoThermal_C.name: Geothermal Generator
Build_GeneratorGeoThermal_C.desc:
Harnesses geothermal energy to generate power. Must be built on a Geyser.

Caution: Power production fluctuates.

Power Production:
Impure Geyser: 50-150 MW (100 MW average)
Normal Geyser: 100-300 MW (200 MW average)
Pure Geyser: 200-600 MW (400 MW average)

Build_AlienPowerBuilding_C.name: Alien Power Augmenter
Build_AlienPowerBuilding_C.desc:
Generates power based on the total amount of power on the attached power grid.

This experimental technology is somehow able to extract power from the Somersloop by blasting it with energy.

Build_PowerStorageMk1_C.name: Power Storage
Build_PowerStorageMk1_C.desc:
Connects to a power grid to store excess power produced. The stored power can be harnessed if power grid consumption exceeds production.

Storage Capacity: 100 MWh (100 MW for 1 hour)
Maximum Charge Rate: 100 MW
Maximum Discharge Rate: Unlimited

Build_PowerPoleWall_C.name: Wall Outlet Mk.1
Build_PowerPoleWall_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall.

Allows for up to 4 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleMk1_C.name: Power Pole Mk.1
Build_PowerPoleMk1_C.desc:
Allows for up to 4 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators, and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_C.name: Double Wall Outlet Mk.1
Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall. Has one connector on each side of the wall.

Allows for up to 4 Power Line connections per side.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_Mk2_C.name: Double Wall Outlet Mk.2
Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_Mk2_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall. Has one connector on each side of the wall.

Allows for up to 7 Power Line connections per side.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleWall_Mk2_C.name: Wall Outlet Mk.2
Build_PowerPoleWall_Mk2_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall.

Allows for up to 7 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_Mk3_C.name: Double Wall Outlet Mk.3
Build_PowerPoleWallDouble_Mk3_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall. Has one connector on each side of the wall.

Allows for up to 10 Power Line connections per side.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleWall_Mk3_C.name: Wall Outlet Mk.3
Build_PowerPoleWall_Mk3_C.desc:
Functions like a Power Pole, but attaches to a wall.

Allows for up to 10 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleMk2_C.name: Power Pole Mk.2
Build_PowerPoleMk2_C.desc:
Allows for up to 7 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators, and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerPoleMk3_C.name: Power Pole Mk.3
Build_PowerPoleMk3_C.desc:
Allows for up to 10 Power Line connections.

Connect Power Poles, Power Generators, and factory buildings with Power Lines to create a power grid. The power grid supplies all connected buildings with power.

Build_PowerTower_C.name: Power Tower
Build_PowerTower_C.desc:
Helps span Power Lines across greater distances.
There is an additional power connector at the bottom of the Power Tower to connect it to other buildings, such as Power Poles.

Build_PowerTowerPlatform_C.name: Power Tower Platform
Build_PowerTowerPlatform_C.desc:
Helps span Power Lines across greater distances.
There is an additional power connector at the bottom of the Power Tower to connect it to other buildings, such as Power Poles.

Note: This Power Tower variant includes a ladder and platform for improved utility.

Build_PowerLine_C.name: Power Line
Build_PowerLine_C.desc: Connects Power Poles, Power Generators, and factory buildings.

Build_PowerSwitch_C.name: Power Switch
Build_PowerSwitch_C.desc:
Enables/disables the connection between 2 power grids when switched ON/OFF.

Note the A and B connector labels.

Build_PriorityPowerSwitch_C.name: Priority Power Switch
Build_PriorityPowerSwitch_C.desc: Priority Power Switches can be ranked by priority. When power production is too low, Switches will start turning off automatically until the power stabilizes, starting with Priority Group 8.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk1_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.1
Build_ConveyorBeltMk1_C.desc: Transports up to 60 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk5_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.5
Build_ConveyorBeltMk5_C.desc: Transports up to 780 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk6_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.6
Build_ConveyorBeltMk6_C.desc: Transports up to 1200 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk4_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.4
Build_ConveyorBeltMk4_C.desc: Transports up to 480 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk3_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.3
Build_ConveyorBeltMk3_C.desc: Transports up to 270 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorBeltMk2_C.name: Conveyor Belt Mk.2
Build_ConveyorBeltMk2_C.desc: Transports up to 120 resources per minute. Used to move resources between buildings.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk1_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.1
Build_ConveyorLiftMk1_C.desc: Transports up to 60 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk5_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.5
Build_ConveyorLiftMk5_C.desc: Transports up to 780 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk6_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.6
Build_ConveyorLiftMk6_C.desc: Transports up to 1200 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk4_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.4
Build_ConveyorLiftMk4_C.desc: Transports up to 480 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk3_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.3
Build_ConveyorLiftMk3_C.desc: Transports up to 270 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorLiftMk2_C.name: Conveyor Lift Mk.2
Build_ConveyorLiftMk2_C.desc: Transports up to 120 resources per minute. Used to move resources between floors.

Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitter_C.name: Conveyor Splitter
Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitter_C.desc:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three.
Useful for diverting parts and resources away from backlogged Conveyor Belts.

Build_ConveyorAttachmentMerger_C.name: Conveyor Merger
Build_ConveyorAttachmentMerger_C.desc: Merges up to three Conveyor Belts into one.

Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitterProgramm.name: Programmable Splitter
Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitterProgramm.desc:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three.
Multiple filters can be set for each output to allow specific parts to pass through.

Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitterSmart_C.name: Smart Splitter
Build_ConveyorAttachmentSplitterSmart_C.desc:
Splits one Conveyor Belt into two or three.
A filter can be set for each output to allow a specific part to pass through.

Build_ConveyorAttachmentMergerPriority_C.name: Priority Merger
Build_ConveyorAttachmentMergerPriority_C.desc:
Merges up to three Conveyor Belts into one.
Inputs can be prioritized to always be merged before others.

Build_ConveyorMonitor_C.name: Conveyor Throughput Monitor
Build_ConveyorMonitor_C.desc:
Attaches to Conveyor Belts.
Monitors the number of parts travelling through it and displays the average throughput per minute.

NOTE: Requires a full minute of data before complete accuracy is achieved.

Build_Pipeline_C.name: Pipeline Mk.1
Build_Pipeline_C.desc:
Transports fluids.
External indicators show flow rate, direction, and volume.
Capacity: 300 m³ of fluid per minute.

Build_PipelineMK2_C.name: Pipeline Mk.2
Build_PipelineMK2_C.desc:
Transports fluids.
External indicators show flow rate, direction, and volume.
Capacity: 600 m³ of fluid per minute.

Build_Valve_C.name: Valve
Build_Valve_C.desc:
Limits Pipeline flow rates.
Can be attached to a Pipeline.

NOTE: Has an in- and output direction.

Build_PipelinePump_C.name: Pipeline Pump Mk.1
Build_PipelinePump_C.desc:
Can be attached to a Pipeline to apply Head Lift.
Maximum Head Lift: 20 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 20 meters upwards.)

NOTE: Arrows and holograms when building indicate Head Lift direction.
NOTE: Head Lift does not stack, so space between Pumps is recommended.

Build_PipelinePumpMk2_C.name: Pipeline Pump Mk.2
Build_PipelinePumpMk2_C.desc:
Can be attached to a Pipeline to apply Head Lift.
Maximum Head Lift: 50 m
(Allows fluids to be transported 50 meters upwards.)

NOTE: Arrows and holograms when building indicate Head Lift direction.
NOTE: Head Lift does not stack, so space between Pumps is recommended.

Build_PipeStorageTank_C.name: Fluid Buffer
Build_PipeStorageTank_C.desc:
Holds up to 400 m³ of fluid.
Has Pipeline input and output ports.

Build_IndustrialTank_C.name: Industrial Fluid Buffer
Build_IndustrialTank_C.desc:
Holds up to 2400 m³ of fluid.
Has Pipeline input and output ports.

Build_PipelineJunction_Cross_C.name: Pipeline Junction
Build_PipelineJunction_Cross_C.desc: Attaches to a Pipeline, allowing it to be split up to 4 ways.

Build_PipelineJunction_T_C.name: Pipeline T-Junction
Build_PipelineJunction_T_C.desc: Attaches to a Pipeline, allowing it to be split up to 3 ways.

Build_StorageContainerMk1_C.name: Storage Container
Build_StorageContainerMk1_C.desc:
Contains 24 slots for storing large amounts of items.
Has 1 Conveyor Belt input port and 1 Conveyor Belt output port.

Build_StorageMedkit_C.name: Medical Storage Box
Build_StorageMedkit_C.desc: Contains 25 slots for storing large amounts of items.

Build_StorageHazard_C.name: Hazard Storage Box
Build_StorageHazard_C.desc: Contains 25 slots for storing large amounts of items.

Build_StorageContainerMk2_C.name: Industrial Storage Container
Build_StorageContainerMk2_C.desc:
Contains 48 slots for storing large amounts of items.
Has 2 Conveyor Belt input ports and 2 Conveyor Belt output ports.

Build_StoragePlayer_C.name: Personal Storage Box
Build_StoragePlayer_C.desc: Contains 25 slots for storing large amounts of items.

Build_StackableShelf_C.name: Basic Shelf Unit
Build_StackableShelf_C.desc: A stackable shelf. Each one can hold two Personal Storage Boxes.

Build_CentralStorage_C.name: Dimensional Depot Uploader
Build_CentralStorage_C.desc:
The Dimensional Depot Uploader is used to upload resources to a dimensional storage deposit.
From here resources can be used by the Build Gun and Crafting Stations, as if they were in the pioneer Inventory.

Build_RailroadTrack_C.name: Railway
Build_RailroadTrack_C.desc:
Carries trains reliably and quickly.
Has a wide turn angle, so make sure to plan it out properly.

Build_TrainStation_C.name: Train Station
Build_TrainStation_C.desc:
Serves as a hub for Locomotives, which can be set to navigate to and stop at a Train Station.
You can connect power to a Train Station to power up the trains on the Railway as well as feed power to other stations.

Build_TrainDockingStation_C.name: Freight Platform
Build_TrainDockingStation_C.desc:
Loads and unloads Freight Cars that stop at the Freight Platform.
Loading and unloading options can be set by configuring the building.
Snaps to other Platforms and Stations.
Needs to be connected to a powered Railway to function.

Build_TrainDockingStationLiquid_C.name: Fluid Freight Platform
Build_TrainDockingStationLiquid_C.desc:
Loads and unloads Freight Cars that stop at the Freight Platform.
Loading and unloading options can be set by configuring the building.
Snaps to other Platforms and Stations.
Needs to be connected to a powered Railway to function.

Build_RailroadPathSignal_C.name: Path Signal
Build_RailroadPathSignal_C.desc:
Directs the movement of trains to avoid collisions and bottlenecks.

Path Signals are advanced signals that are especially useful for bi-directional Railways and complex intersections. They function similarly to Block Signals, but rather than occupying the entire Block, trains can reserve a specific path through it and will only enter the Block if their path allows them to fully pass through.

Caution: Signals are directional! Trains are unable to move against this direction, so be sure to set up Signals in both directions for bi-directional Railways.

Build_RailroadBlockSignal_C.name: Block Signal
Build_RailroadBlockSignal_C.desc:
Directs the movement of trains to avoid collisions and bottlenecks.

Block Signals can be placed on Railways to create 'Blocks' between them. When a train is occupying one of these Blocks, other trains will be unable to enter it.

Caution: Signals are directional! Trains are unable to move against this direction, so be sure to set up Signals in both directions for bi-directional Railways.

Build_FluidTruckStation_C.name: Fluid Truck Station
Build_FluidTruckStation_C.desc:
Sends or receives fluid to/from vehicles.

Has 3200 m³ of fluid storage capacity.

Always refuels vehicles to maximum capacity if fuel is available. Fuel types can be prioritised.

Build_TruckStation_C.name: Truck Station
Build_TruckStation_C.desc:
Sends or receives resources to/from vehicles.

Has 48 inventory slots.

Transfers up to 120 stacks per minute to/from docked vehicles.
Always refuels vehicles if it has access to a matching fuel type.

Build_DroneStation_C.name: Drone Port
Build_DroneStation_C.desc:
Functions as home Port to a single Drone, which transports available input back and forth between its home Port and destination Port.
Drone Ports can have one other Port assigned as their transport destination.

The Drone Port interface provides delivery details and allows management of Port connections.

Build_PipeHyper_C.name: Hypertube
Build_PipeHyper_C.desc:
Transports FICSIT employees.
A Hypertube system cannot be powered up or used until a Hypertube Entrance is attached.

Build_PipeHyperStart_C.name: Hypertube Entrance
Build_PipeHyperStart_C.desc: Powers up a Hypertube system and allows it to be entered.

Build_JumpPadAdjustable_C.name: Jump Pad
Build_JumpPadAdjustable_C.desc:
Launches pioneers for quick, vertical traversal.
The launch angle can be adjusted while building.
Caution: Be sure to land safely!

Build_Elevator_C.name: Personnel Elevator
Build_Elevator_C.desc:
Transports FICSIT personnel between floors while meeting acceptable standards for efficiency and safety.
Consumes power when in use and transports power between all attached Elevator Floor Stops.

NOTE: Additional floor stops can be added with an Elevator Floor Stop.

Build_Portal_C.name: Main Portal
Build_Portal_C.desc:
Enables pioneer teleportation between two linked Portals.

Each Portal can only have a single link.
A link can only be made between a Main and Satellite Portal.

Singularity Cells need to be supplied to the Main Portal and will be consumed to establish and maintain the Portal link.

WARNINGS:
- Massive power draw will occur during start-up and usage.
- Power draw on use increases with travel distance.
- Link start-up will take time. Letting the connection expire is not recommended.
- Failure to deliver sufficient Singularity Cells will cause the link to expire.
- FICSIT does not condone the use of wormhole technology. Any usage of wormhole technology is at the user's own risk.

Build_PortalSatellite_C.name: Satellite Portal
Build_PortalSatellite_C.desc:
Enables pioneer teleportation between two linked Portals.

Each Portal can only have a single link.
A link can only be made between a Main and Satellite Portal.

Singularity Cells need to be supplied to the Main Portal and will be consumed to establish and maintain the Portal link.

WARNINGS:
- Massive power draw will occur during start-up and usage.
- Power draw on use increases with travel distance.
- Link start-up will take time. Letting the connection expire is not recommended.
- Failure to deliver sufficient Singularity Cells will cause the link to expire.
- FICSIT does not condone the use of wormhole technology. Any usage of wormhole technology is at the user's own risk.

Build_TradingPost_C.name: The HUB
Build_TradingPost_C.desc: The heart of your factory. This is where you complete FICSIT milestones to unlock additional schematics for buildings, vehicles, parts, equipment, etc.

Build_SpaceElevator_C.name: Space Elevator
Build_SpaceElevator_C.desc:
Requires deliveries of special Project Parts to complete Project Assembly Phases.
Completing these Phases will unlock new Tiers in the HUB Terminal.

Build_Mam_C.name: MAM
Build_Mam_C.desc:
The Molecular Analysis Machine is used to analyze new and exotic materials found on alien planets.
Through the MAM, R&D will assist pioneers in turning any valuable data into usable research options and new technologies.

Build_ResourceSink_C.name: AWESOME Sink
Build_ResourceSink_C.desc:
Got excess resources? Fear not, for FICSIT does not waste! The newly developed AWESOME Sink turns any and all useful parts into research data just as fast as you can supply them!
Participating pioneers will be compensated with Coupons that can be spent at the AWESOME Shop.

Build_ResourceSinkShop_C.name: AWESOME Shop
Build_ResourceSinkShop_C.desc:
Redeem your FICSIT Coupons here!
For those employees going the extra kilometer we have set aside special bonus milestones and rewards! Get your Coupons in the AWESOME Sink program now!

*No refunds possible.

Build_RadarTower_C.name: Radar Tower
Build_RadarTower_C.desc:
Scans the surrounding area to display additional information on the Map.

Information revealed on the Map includes:
- Resource node locations
- Terrain data
- Flora & fauna information
- Notable signal readings

Build_BlueprintDesigner_Mk3_C.name: Blueprint Designer Mk.3
Build_BlueprintDesigner_Mk3_C.desc:
The Blueprint Designer is used to create custom factory designs and save them as Blueprints.
Blueprints can be accessed from the Blueprint tab of the Build Menu.

Note that buildings can only be placed in the Blueprint Designer if they are fully within the boundary frame.

Dimensions: 48 m x 48 m x 48 m

Build_BlueprintDesigner_MK2_C.name: Blueprint Designer Mk.2
Build_BlueprintDesigner_MK2_C.desc:
The Blueprint Designer is used to create custom factory designs and save them as Blueprints.
Blueprints can be accessed from the Blueprint tab of the Build Menu.

Note that buildings can only be placed in the Blueprint Designer if they are fully within the boundary frame.

Dimensions: 40 m x 40 m x 40 m

Build_BlueprintDesigner_C.name: Blueprint Designer Mk.1
Build_BlueprintDesigner_C.desc:
The Blueprint Designer is used to create custom factory designs and save them as Blueprints.
Blueprints can be accessed from the Blueprint tab of the Build Menu.

Note that buildings can only be placed in the Blueprint Designer if they are fully within the boundary frame.

Dimensions: 32 m x 32 m x 32 m

Build_WorkBench_C.name: Crafting Bench
Build_WorkBench_C.desc:
Allows you to manually craft a wide range of different parts.
These parts can then be used to construct various factory buildings, vehicles, and equipment.

Build_LookoutTower_C.name: Lookout Tower
Build_LookoutTower_C.desc: Provides a good vantage point to facilitate factory construction.

Desc_CyberWagon_C.name: Cyber Wagon
Desc_CyberWagon_C.desc:
Absolutely indestructible.
Needs no further introduction.

Desc_DroneTransport_C.name: Drone
Desc_DroneTransport_C.desc:
Transports available input back and forth between its home Port and destination Ports. Drone Status and other details can be viewed at a Drone's home Port.
Must be built on a Drone Port.

Has 9 inventory slots.

Can use any fuel type.
Refuels at any of its connected Ports if possible.

Desc_Explorer_C.name: Explorer
Desc_Explorer_C.desc:
Traverses rough terrain, including near-vertical surfaces. A fast and nimble exploration vehicle.

Has 12 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type

Desc_FreightWagon_C.name: Freight Car
Desc_FreightWagon_C.desc:
Attaches to an Electric Locomotive or other Freight Car to transport resources. Must be built on a Railway.
Resources are loaded and unloaded at Freight Platforms.
Has a 2400 m³ or 32-slot capacity, depending on whether resources are liquid or solid.

Desc_Locomotive_C.name: Electric Locomotive
Desc_Locomotive_C.desc:
Moves Freight Cars from station to station.
Requires between 25-110 MW of power to move.
Must be built on a Railway.

Nicknamed 'Leif' by FICSIT pioneers because of its reliability.

Desc_FluidTruck_C.name: Fluid Truck
Desc_FluidTruck_C.desc:
Picks up and delivers liquids at Fluid Truck Stations. This process can be automated. Nicknamed 'The Soda Can' by FICSIT pioneers because of its bi-cylindrical frame.

Has a capacity of 3200 m³ for fluid storage.

Fuel: Any fuel type

Desc_Truck_C.name: Truck
Desc_Truck_C.desc:
Picks up and delivers resources at Truck Stations. This process can be automated. Nicknamed 'The Unit' by FICSIT pioneers because of its massive frame.

Has 48 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type

Desc_Tractor_C.name: Tractor
Desc_Tractor_C.desc:
Picks up and delivers resources at Truck Stations. This process can be automated. Nicknamed 'Sugarcube' by FICSIT pioneers with the justification “It’s pretty sweet, y’know”.

Has 25 inventory slots and a built-in Crafting Bench.

Fuel: Any fuel type
